**Conversion rules:**
- `req.params.x` → `ctx.param("x")`
- `req.query.x` → `ctx.query("x")`
- `req.body` → `await ctx.json<T>()` (call once, store in variable)
- `req.actor` → `ctx.actor`
- `req.actor.type` → `ctx.actor?.type`
- `req.actor.userId` → use `getActorInfo(ctx).actorId` or check `ctx.actor.type === "board" && (ctx.actor as BoardActor).userId`
- `res.json(data)` → `return Response.json(data)`
- `res.status(N).json(data)` → `return Response.json(data, { status: N })`
- `res.setHeader("Content-Type", "image/svg+xml"); res.send(svg)` → `return new Response(svg, { headers: { "Content-Type": "image/svg+xml" } })`
- `res.set("Cache-Control", ...); res.json(data)` → `return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": "..." } })`
- `assertCompanyAccess(req, id)` → `assertCompanyAccess(ctx, id)` (no cast needed)
- `assertBoard(req)` → `assertBoard(ctx)`
- `assertInstanceAdmin(req)` → `assertInstanceAdmin(ctx)`
